description.content: Applied to Survivors by The Doctor, increasing in tiers:

items: [Madness I]: [33%] of Skill Checks become Madness Skill Checks.
[Madness II]: Survivors also see Illusionary Doctors.
[Madness III]: Survivors scream periodically, revealing their Aura, and suffer from [Incapacitated].

description.content: At [Madness III], Survivors use <Snap Out of It> to return to [Madness I].
